entity.summary: Brazil-based centralized cryptocurrency exchange operated by Coinext, providing spot purchase and sale, custody, staking, fiat and crypto transfers, advanced orders, web and mobile trading, and API services.
entity.notes: The current first-party site exposes live markets, registration, app and web trading, spot purchase and sale, deposits and withdrawals, staking, advanced orders, and API services. Current terms identify the operating company and define crypto purchase, sale, storage, and transaction services. No exact launch date or lifecycle event is asserted.
